title: It’s the Humans, Not the Data: Geopolitical Bias in LLMs Originates in Post-Training, Amplified by the Language of the Prompt

bias_targets.methodology: Forced-choice multiple-choice question (MCQ) probe evaluating which of two countries acted more justifiably across 79 paired two-country geopolitical scenarios, measuring token probabilities across multiple languages.

Counterfactual substitution of real country names with fictional names carrying specific ethnolinguistic phonetic cues (e.g., Anglo, Chinese, Arabic, Slavic) within the scenario prompts to determine if biases persist based on phonetic identity.
